card.name: Comma after overdose opening phrase
card.fires_on: The comma right after an opening phrase such as "In case of overdose" or "In managing overdosage" in overdose-treatment sections of drug labels.

modes.label: In case of overdose,
modes.description: Comma after the standard opener at the start of a treatment-of-overdose paragraph.

modes.label: In managing overdosage,
modes.description: Comma after the opener in the management-of-overdosage section, before the multiple-drug advice.
modes.example: In managing overdosage<<,>> consider the possibility of multiple drug involvement.

card.plain: It fires on the comma after the opening phrase of an overdose-treatment paragraph, just before the instructions begin.
